question: Which of the following sports events is NOT included in the scheme of cash awards in India to medal winners and their coaches in international sports events?
solution:
The correct answer is** __Cricket.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Scheme of Cash Awards to Medal Winners in International Sports Events and their Coaches**

 
 
• The cash awards were first given out in **1986**, and they were changed in **2020**.
 
• To reward outstanding athletes for their accomplishments, **to inspire and motivate **them to achieve greater heights, and to serve as role models that **encourage younger people **to take up sports.
 
 
• The following fields will **receive the awards**:
 
 
• Chess,
 
• Billiards, and
 
• Snooker

 are **Olympic, Asian, and Commonwealth Games sports.**
 
 
 
 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Schemes of Cash Awards, National Welfare and Pension to Sportspersons** 

 
 
• The revised Cash Awards, National Welfare, and Pension schemes for athletes were announced by the **Union Minister for the Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports**.
 
• **Amendments in the Schemes**
 
 
• **Direct Applicability for these Schemes**: Previously, proposals were received through **Sports Federations/SAI**, which typically took more than one to two years. Now, any individual sportsperson can directly apply for all three schemes.
 
• **Pension to Meritorious Sportspersons**: The **Deaflympics athletes** have also been included in the expansion of pension benefits.
 
• **National Sports Development Fund’ (NSDF)**: Corporate social responsibility contributions from** Central and State Governments**, **Public Sector Undertakings (PSUs)**, private businesses, individuals, and others make up the** foundation** of this fund. for the country's** sports development and promotion.**
